text:
Both teams arrive on skids. DET is 1-4-0 in its last five and winless in three, coming off a 4-0 loss at COL where Mackenzie Blackwood stopped all 27 shots. They're without Dylan Larkin (suspended), Albert Johansson and Marco Kasper. Emmitt Finnie has taken Larkin's spot beside Lucas Raymond and Viktor Arvidsson, and Andrew Copp is up to 19:25 a night. STL is also winless in three (0-2-1) after a 3-1 loss at NSH, missing Dillon Dube. DET won't forget the Oct 31 meeting, a 5-4 STL win. Justin Faulk also plays in St. Louis for the first time since leaving the Blues.

The chances are close. DET has 53% of the expected goals (the quality of shots taken and allowed) at five on five, STL 48%, and our model has it 2.99 to 2.96 tonight. DET's trouble is finishing: 11.1 fewer goals than its chances usually produce. It also takes 4.1 penalties a game against an STL power play creating 0.54 expected goals a game. In net, projected starters John Gibson (DET) is at -6.3 goals saved above expected this season, while Joel Hofer (STL) is at +5.9. Last season, both were positive.

Alex DeBrincat (35% to score) leads DET, a 39th overall pick in 2016 who put up 127 points in 63 OHL games. Jimmy Snuggerud (29%) and Mason McTavish (28%) top STL. Our under-the-radar pick is Philip Broberg, 51% for a point tonight, up from 44% on his season pace because his projected ice time is 26:41 a night against 24:35.
